names: Magnesium carbonates: (i) magnesium carbonate (ii) magnesium hydroxide carbonate

more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Magnesium carbonates is used as an anti-caking agent in food. Its technological role is to help powders stay free-flowing.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include edible caseinates, ripened cheese, cheese products (excluding products falling in category 16), salt. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
